technical_review.notes: All objectives, assessments, modules, and lessons are correctly linked with no orphaned entities[cite: 15].

special_question.answer: Yes, it is pedagogically reasonable, but the time constraints are extremely tight.
special_question.notes: The 60-minute time constraint may not allow sufficient depth for the complex evaluative and generative tasks assigned[cite: 15].

rubric_scores.rationale: The success criteria are generally observable, though measuring how well a learner 'considers tradeoffs' requires qualitative judgment[cite: 15].
The scenario-based summative assessment maps perfectly to the stated performances of interpreting, diagnosing, and proposing actions[cite: 15].
A simulated dashboard scenario is a valid proxy for real-world monitoring, provided the fidelity of the provided metrics is high[cite: 15].
The instructional verbs (analyze, evaluate, create) are properly matched with the complexity of the tasks in both instruction and assessment[cite: 15].
There is a heavy prerequisite load (five distinct capabilities) for a short 60-minute module, which may limit the target audience[cite: 15].
The progression from interpreting signals to diagnosing causes to recommending actions follows the natural engineering workflow seamlessly[cite: 15].
Formative practice lessons directly mirror the sub-skills needed for the summative assessment[cite: 15].
Teaching diagnosis and response strategies within 60 minutes leaves very little time for deep conceptual exploration or handling edge cases[cite: 15].
The content remains strictly focused on the required outcomes with no extraneous material[cite: 15].
Requires only minor adjustments to time estimates and potential consolidation of prerequisites.

prerequisite_acceptance.notes: prereq-model-monitoring-005 is labeled as 'helpful_background' and can be discarded to simplify entry requirements[cite: 15].

edit_effort.notes: Drop the non-essential prerequisite and slightly rebalance the time budget to ensure the summative task is feasible.

pedagogical_review.overall_notes: A well-structured design that effectively captures the troubleshooting workflow, though it demands a fast pace from the learner[cite: 15].
